notes.title: 【Announcing Update Version 0.1.1】
notes.content:
Thank you for playing "Slug's Sister Defense".

The update to version 0.1.1 was released on December/6 (JST 18:00) for bug fixes.
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused to our users, despite the game being newly released.

The details of the update are as follows.

◆ Bug Fixes
　・Fixed an issue where the second type of monster, "Oculus," which uses the skill "Laser Beam," had 0 HP upon appearing for the second and subsequent times.
　・Fixed an issue where the credits remained displayed on the mini-map.
　・Fixed an issue where enemies resumed movement if the pause screen was opened while the Time Freeze item's effect was active.

We look forward to your continued support of "Slug's Sister Defense".
